_doc: Free-roaming dogs (story 6.1; epic 7 builds the chasing neighbor dog on them). States: CALM stands, CHASE trots after the nearest player and stops `stopDistance` away (never hurts), FETCH is driven by ai/DogFetch.js. `fetch`: range = how far from the dog a landed stick must be, pickup = distance at which it grabs the stick, dropDistance = how far from the thrower it lets go, speed / returnSpeed in px/s, happy = seconds of celebrating, giveUp = seconds before a fetch is dropped.
